scope: US WWII fighters; original USAAF/USN flight-test memoranda, contemporary flight manuals and original manufacturer specifications; postwar original type tests separately marked
rules: Stall IAS is never silently rebranded CAS/EAS: instrument-error removed is NOT equivalent to position-error removed.
Source summary gross/takeoff weight is not instantaneous stall weight. Rows have exact_weight_lb only where a test explicitly supplies it.
Rows store reported (not mathematically interpolated) figures. Sea-level minimum speed and unspecified speed-basis values are not certified aerodynamic CLmax benchmarks.
Power-on stalls need thrust/propeller modelling and are not pure wing-CLmax anchors.
Vendor specification projections, flight-test measurements and pilot-manual operational figures are separately classified.
Source PDF page is zero-based only if indicated pdf_page0; otherwise use report section/table or printed page. Some original scans remain untranscribed.

speed_basis_definitions.IAS_raw: Uncorrected aircraft indicated airspeed; no instrument or position correction.
speed_basis_definitions.IAS_instrument_corrected: Original explicitly removed ASI instrument error; pitot-static position error still uncorrected unless specifically documented.
speed_basis_definitions.IAS_undetermined_correction: Original says IAS, does not state what instrument/position corrections were applied.
speed_basis_definitions.CAS_explicit: Original explicitly calls speed calibrated airspeed; not EAS until compressibility treatment specified.
speed_basis_definitions.mph_unspecified: Original gives mph/minimum speed without identifying IAS/CAS/TAS; cannot assume any one.
speed_basis_definitions.manual_IAS: Contemporary pilot handbook's operational indication; may have separate position-error charts.
